# Draft:Canadian Championship ranking index

The Canadian Championship ranking index ranks the performance of Canadian soccer clubs in the Canadian Championship, Canada's national soccer cup competition. The ranking index is used to determine which teams enter which pot during each tournament's draw, as well as determining hosting-rights for matches in some rounds of the competition.
The index was first established ahead of the 2024 tournament, which awarded points to clubs based on their performance in the tournament over the past 3 tournaments. Ahead of the 2026 tournament the formula was modified to use the weighted results from the past 4 years. Canada Soccer has never released the formula for how each rank is calculated.
Professional clubs that compete in the tournament every year have their own individual ranks, while semi-pro teams from the Premier Soccer Leagues Canada are ranked collectively by the performance of their league's representative at previous tournaments.
